# ADR-3232: AWS logging: CloudWatch log group without retention for app 8

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Infinite retention explodes cost; zero loses forensics.

## Decision

Apps SHALL NOT create a CloudWatch log group without retention for app 8 (AWS-logging-8) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Retention matches the data classification.
